title: Refund Form and Settlement Times by Hotel Rate Plan
content:
Where money is returned on a reservation booked in the Hotel Rate Plans range, the form it is returned in and the time the settlement takes are fixed by the plan booked.

| Rate plan | Form value is returned in | Settlement, business days |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | none | 0 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | original payment | 14 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | original payment | 10 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | original payment | 7 |
| Member Flex Rate | original payment | 7 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | original payment | 7 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | property credit | 10 |

The form column takes one of three values: none, where nothing is returned; property credit, where value is returned as credit at the property; and original payment, where money goes back to the form of payment it came from. The settlement column is the number of business days the settlement of an approved refund takes.

**Basis questions.** *Which plans of the range return nothing at all?* The Non-Refundable Saver Rate alone carries the form value none, and its settlement figure is accordingly 0 business days. *Which plan returns value other than as money?* The All-Inclusive Flex Rate returns value as property credit, over 10 business days. *Which plan is slowest to settle in money?* The Advance Purchase 21 Rate, at 14 business days; the Standard Flexible Rate, the Member Flex Rate and the Suite Flexible Rate are the quickest, at 7.
